# appendEvent

commonJvmAndroid

suspend override fun [appendEvent](append-event.html)(session: [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html), event: [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)): [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html)

Appends [event](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html) to [session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html), applying its state delta to the in-memory session and recording the event; `temp:` keys are applied to the in-memory state (so later agents in the invocation can read them) but removed from [event](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html) before persistence.

Overriding implementations must run this lifecycle before persisting so the stored event has no `temp:` keys: call `super.appendEvent` first then persist the trimmed [event](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session-service/append-event.html), or call [State.applyTempDelta](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-state/apply-temp-delta.html) and [com.google.adk.kt.events.EventActions.removeTempKeys](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event-actions/remove-temp-keys.html) before persisting with `super.appendEvent` last (needed when a stale-write check must read the pre-update [Session.lastUpdateTime](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/last-update-time.html)).

Overrides must also return early when [Event.partial](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/partial.html) is true, before running this lifecycle: `super.appendEvent` skips partials without trimming `temp:` keys, so persisting after `super` would store an untrimmed partial event.

#### Return

The appended [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html), or the original unchanged if it was partial.

#### Parameters

 _session_

The [Session](../../com.google.adk.kt.sessions/-session/index.html) to update in place.

_event_

The [Event](../../com.google.adk.kt.events/-event/index.html) to append; its `temp:` state-delta keys are removed in place.
